description: Defines the CachingDeviceAllocator namespace with DeviceStats struct and DeviceAllocator class, including methods for device memory management and statistics.

classes.name: DeviceAllocator
classes.description: Abstract class for device memory allocation and management, including statistics retrieval and cache management.

methods.name: initialized
methods.description: Checks if the allocator has been properly initialized.

methods.name: emptyCache
methods.description: Releases all cached device memory from a specified memory pool.

methods.name: recordStream
methods.description: Associates a memory allocation with a stream for dependency tracking.

methods.name: getDeviceStats
methods.description: Retrieves comprehensive memory statistics for a device.

methods.name: resetAccumulatedStats
methods.description: Resets cumulative allocation statistics for a device.

methods.name: resetPeakStats
methods.description: Resets peak memory usage statistics for a device.

methods.name: getMemoryInfo
methods.description: Returns free and total memory size in bytes for a device.
